# Monitoring Documentation

Production monitoring records should identify:

- Monitoring platform
- SRX management address
- Monitoring protocol
- SNMP version if used
- Monitored interfaces
- Alert thresholds
- Logging destination
- Configuration state
- Verification date

Configuration state must be one of:

LEGACY_PRODUCTION

SRX320_TARGET

SRX320_VERIFIED_PRODUCTION

---
